description: This file defines a custom Android button class 'StaticPointerIconButton' that overrides pointer icon resolution to provide a static custom pointer icon when interacted with.

classes.name: StaticPointerIconButton
classes.description: A custom Button subclass that provides a static pointer icon when hovered or interacted with.

methods.name: onResolvePointerIcon
methods.description: Overrides default pointer icon resolution to provide a custom icon based on a drawable resource.

methods.name: <constructors>
methods.description: Various constructors to initialize the button with different attribute sets.
